currentWork.title: FINAL.26 route mode/orientation — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.26 is live. PR #150 merged to main at efd6ab30c6ac4937ff2cec482cbac450127ee75f. Vercel production dpl_Ctz1iykQeqkf7idiDF9rCFQuBV4N is READY. GitHub Pages deployment run 37487664235 succeeded from main 3b587e9993ff12c4e8947d9e36da87cd006845a6, and the live version endpoint reports 2026.10.06-FINAL.26.
scope: ORS motorway classification remains deterministic from waycategory bit 1; motorway/motorway_link sections render orange and ordinary road sections blue.
Route status explicitly shows whether the returned route contains a motorway section and whether toll avoidance is active.
The vehicle settings explain that toll avoidance ON tends to avoid expressways; the user's saved preference is not silently changed.
Non-MAP mobile screens are portrait-first with Screen Orientation lock when supported and an in-app landscape guard fallback.
MAP is landscape-capable and provides an app-managed full-viewport button, using native Fullscreen and landscape lock opportunistically when supported.
Analytics engine, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits, route vehicle settings and user data remain unchanged.
